items.title: AWS engineer reports PostgreSQL perf halved by Linux 7.0, fix may not be easy
items.summary: A report highlights significant performance degradation of PostgreSQL on AWS instances running Linux 7.0. The performance drop is attributed to changes in Linux kernel optimizations, potentially impacting database operations. The issue is not straightforward to resolve, requiring coordinated efforts between AWS and the Linux community. This could affect cloud-hosted database services, leading to increased costs or service disruptions.
items.why_it_matters: Tech leads need to be aware of potential performance impacts on cloud-based PostgreSQL deployments, which may require adjustments or alternative solutions.

items.title: microsoft/agent-framework
items.summary: Microsoft has introduced a new framework to build, orchestrate, and deploy AI agents and multi-agent workflows. The framework supports both Python and .NET, providing a versatile solution for integrating AI capabilities into applications. It aims to simplify the process of managing complex AI systems, allowing developers to focus on application logic.

items.title: scan-for-secrets 0.2
